why: Found with the real generator on 02/09, asked for by the owner. The CONTENT placeholder is inert and loud: the build fails while a TROQUE- is left — the token stays Portuguese because it is the literal `new/site/aplicar.mjs` writes. The GATE placeholder was inert and MUTE — the generator did not find the git identity, wrote "DONO NÃO CONFIGURADO" (also a literal, written by `new/index.mjs`) in NOTICE, README and .rebar-coauthors, and rebar-check gave 13 of 13, exit 0 on top of that. The worst one is .rebar-coauthors: it is the allowlist of who may sign a commit, and with an @exemplo.invalido e-mail inside it the co-authorship rule stops holding. A gate installed with a placeholder is a gate people learn to switch off in the first week.
